summary: Iter31 — JARVIS Aura visual reskin verified end-to-end on 375px mobile viewport via public preview URL (kishan / Kishan@Boss2026). All 12 review-request items PASS. Sign-in screen renders in deep near-black #07070f with neon-green primary buttons, frosted card, and 'Quick login as Kishan Sir (demo)' button working. Post-login Dashboard shows body bg = rgb(7,7,15) = #07070f, primary numeric text (₹15,760, ₹61,488.78, 0 kg, 35 baht) rendered pure white rgb(255,255,255), section headers (FY 2026-27, Bangkok warehouse, Bullion Module) in neon-green rgb(0,255,136) = #00FF88. Layout unchanged — CUSTOMER WILL PAY and YOU PAY CARRIER render side-by-side ledger row, dash carousel below with dot indicators, Bullion module list follows. Company Switcher chip 'Awadh Enterprise' visible & tappable in header for Admin user. Wingman floating bubble visible bottom-right on Overview tab (green circular icon at ~(333,543)). Tab bar visible with 5 tabs (Overview / Shipments / Invoices / Trips / More); all 5 tabs navigate without layout shift; testIDs tab-index, tab-shipments, tab-invoices, tab-bullion, tab-more all resolve; active glow color per-tab palette applied (Overview cyan #00F5FF confirmed via halo around tab). Ambient background renders 4 blurred orb candidates. No console errors related to theme change (0 theme-related errors — only 1 unrelated 403 resource load). Pre-existing warnings flagged in handoff (shadow* deprecation, useNativeDriver on web) reproduce but are documented as P2 non-blockers.

design_issues.screen: Dashboard (Overview) — ledger row secondary baht values
issues: The ฿ baht equivalents shown beneath the ₹ primary numbers (e.g. '฿10,007' under '₹15,760' and '฿35,225' under '₹61,488.78') render at rgba(255,255,255,0.60) (textMuted) rather than pure white #FFFFFF. Spec says 'all number/stat text WHITE (₹15,760, ₹61,488.78, ฿ balances, KG values, dates, counts)'. Primary ₹ and 0-kg values ARE white; only the sub-line ฿ conversions are muted. LOW priority — this is a legibility trade-off between primary vs secondary line, but flagged per literal spec wording.

'0% of 5000 kg' and '0% of total' sub-labels use textDim rgba(255,255,255,0.45) — acceptable per JARVIS Aura muted-caption pattern (matches inactive tab icons alpha), but spec technically listed 'counts' as white. Consider re-reading spec vs implementation intent.

react_native_issues.component: Ambient orbs / tab bar / particles (Animated on web)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' — pre-existing P2 per handoff, not caused by reskin. Reference: frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:63,68,121,127,173,178 and ambient-background.tsx (Reanimated worklets run fine on web).

Console warns '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' — pre-existing P2 per handoff, not caused by reskin. Reference: frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:439-444 (sparkle), :467-469 (glow) and frontend/src/components/ambient-background.tsx:218-222 (particle shadow).

Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — React Native Web deprecation, pre-existing P2, not caused by reskin. Reference: frontend/src/components/ambient-background.tsx (multiple pointerEvents="none" props), frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:230,237.

action_items: OPTIONAL / LOW: Decide whether the ฿ baht sub-values under the primary ₹ ledger numbers should be pure white #FFFFFF (per literal spec) or remain at textMuted rgba(255,255,255,0.60) as a visual hierarchy signal. Same call for '0% of X' meta captions.

OPTIONAL / P2 (pre-existing, per handoff — do NOT block on this reskin): Sweep remaining shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver deprecations in tab bar, ambient bg, and any residual glass cards to silence RN-Web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: theme/index.ts:126-135 — `metric.*` tokens all export color='#FFFFFF' with per-kind glow. Correctly consumed by metric.tsx per handoff — primary ledger digits render white ✓. However glass-card / secondary baht subvalues in index.tsx appear to use a different token (textMuted). If literal 'all numbers white' is desired, either bump those to colors.text or add an explicit prop.

app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:220-274 — tab bar `visibleHeight = 60 + bottomPad`, shelfHeight = 1.2× (half-cut shelf silhouette). Layout constant TAB_BAR_BOTTOM_PAD = 96 preserved, so downstream screens do NOT need adjustment. Good.
app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:24-30 — TAB_GLOW map is complete for all 5 top-level tabs. Ledger 'gold glow' correctly noted as living inside More menu (not a top-level tab), matching spec.
ambient-background.tsx:143-173 — 35 gold particles built via deterministic LCG so RN reconciler stays stable across re-renders. Good practice; avoids per-render churn.

app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (479 lines) and ambient-background.tsx (283 lines) — well under the 700-line split threshold. index.tsx dashboard remains ~1005 lines from prior iteration (unchanged in this reskin); prior split recommendation still stands but is not caused by this change.
